description: Capability for the main window. The opener plugin needs an explicit path scope: 'allow-open-path' grants the open_path COMMAND but no path, so without scope entries every openPath() call fails with 'Not allowed to open path'. The scoped entries below cover the two call sites (Settings > About > open data dir, and the plugin detail drawer's open plugin folder). The updater permission set enables the full check > download > install workflow, which is what Settings > About > software update needs.
